purpose: confirm that a reviewed change meets the merge conditions and let it into the protected branch, by someone other than its author
entry_criteria: Code review (stage 69) is approved on the current head commit
A merge steward or code owner is available
inputs: branch protection rules and code owners
procedure: Confirm the approvals are on the current head commit and from the required code owners.
Confirm every required check is green and no check was bypassed.
Confirm there are no unresolved blocking comments and no conflicts with the target branch.
Confirm the change fits the release plan or freeze status.
Merge using the agreed method and record who merged and when.
Confirm the target branch pipeline starts and passes after the merge.
acceptance_criteria: Approval is on the head commit being merged
Merger is not the sole author and approver

validation.expect: reviewDecision APPROVED, mergeStateStatus CLEAN, headRefOid equals the reviewed commit

failure_modes.response: Record the reason; review in the next retrospective

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: The steward sees approval from the code owner on commit a1b2c3, all required checks green and no conflicts. The change merges and the main-branch pipeline passes.
